WITH city_address_counts AS (
  SELECT c.city_id, c.city, COUNT(a.address_id) AS address_count
  FROM city c
  LEFT JOIN address a ON a.city_id = c.city_id
  GROUP BY c.city_id, c.city
), totals AS (
  SELECT AVG(address_count) AS avg_addresses_per_city, SUM(address_count) AS total_addresses
  FROM city_address_counts
)
SELECT cac.city_id,
       cac.city,
       cac.address_count,
       cac.address_count / t.avg_addresses_per_city AS relative_to_average,
       cac.address_count / t.total_addresses AS share_of_all_addresses
FROM city_address_counts cac
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC
LIMIT 10;
